info.name: MessMate · 08 · Statements
info.description:
Close kora maser chuda-nto hisheb — immutable snapshot. Reopen korle purono version mochhe na, notun version toiri hoy.
---

### ⚠️ Ei collection ta alada (standalone)

Alada collection-er moddhe **collection variable share hoy na**. Tai sob id
**environment**-e rakha hoy — sob collection ekei environment dekhe.

**Chalanor age:**

1. Upore daan pashe environment dropdown-e **"MessMate — Local"** select kora ache kina dekho
2. **`01 · Auth`** collection theke ei tinta chalao (ekbar chalalei jothesto):
   - `Login — Owner` → token
   - `Me` → messId, membershipId
   - `Setup — load current period` → periodId

Erpor ei collection-er request gulo kaj korbe.

**Environment select na thakle** `{{messId}}` khali theke jabe ar `400` ashbe.

exec: // Mess-er timezone (Asia/Dhaka, UTC+6) dhore date variable set kora hoy,
// jate cutoff test gulo tomar computer-er timezone-e bhul na hoy.
try { pm.environment.set("today", iso(nowDhaka)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("tomorrow", plus(1)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("plus2", plus(2)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("plus3", plus(3)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("farFuture", plus(17)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
try { pm.environment.set("currentMonth", iso(nowDhaka).slice(0, 7)); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Ek maser sob member-er statement — **current calculationVersion-er ta**.

**Prati statement-e:** meal units, meal rate, meal cost, fixed cost, personal cost, opening balance, deposit, gross cost, closing balance, ar `breakdown` JSON-e formula.

**⚠️ Age month close korte hobe** — na hole khali array ashbe.

**Ke parbe:** MANAGER+.

**Expect:** `200`

exec: const s = pm.response.json().data.statements; console.log("statements:", s.length); if (s[0]) console.log("version:", s[0].calculationVersion, "| rate:", s[0].mealRate);

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Shudhu nijer statement — puro byakkha soho.

**Kokhon lagbe:** Member-er "amar hisheb" page.

**Ke parbe:** je kono member. Statement toiri na hole `404`.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Nijer sob maser statement (max 50) — **prati version soho**.

**Keno version:** mash reopen hole purono hisheb-o dekha jay, tai "ager bar 3773 chilo, ekhon 4100 keno" er uttor pawa jay.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Onno member-er statement itihash.

**Ke parbe:** MANAGER+ (STATEMENT_READ_ALL permission).

**Kokhon lagbe:** Member dispute holo — "amar hisheb bhul" — manager mile dekhbe.

**Expect:** `200`
